in_sanskrit.name: निशिठि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is steadfast, unwavering, firm at night

in_marathi.name: Nishithi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nishithi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nisha', meaning 'night', and 'stha', indicating 'end' or 'standing'. It refers to the end of night or dawn, symbolizing hope and new beginnings.
